$comment: Content of the README card pictures. Render with sh1ft-w.github.io/theme/v1/readme-images: node render.mjs <this repo> cards. The title image is the original artwork, unchanged.

new.title: Display and night mode
new.text: The UNAS display is a light with its brightness, the status LED can be turned off, and the night mode has a start and an end, as in UniFi OS.

new.title: Your model's picture
new.text: The UniFi OS and Drive updates show the product picture of your UNAS model, from Ubiquiti's public device catalog.

new.title: Found even when renamed
new.text: A UNAS that no longer carries its default name is still discovered, through Home Assistant's network discovery.

new.title: Remembers its certificate
new.text: At setup the integration remembers the certificate the UNAS shows and only sends the password to that one. If it ever changes, a repair shows the old and the new fingerprint.

features.title: Storage at a glance
features.text: Used, free, capacity and usage over all pools, the storage status and a problem sensor for degraded pools or lost redundancy.

features.title: Every disk its own device
features.text: Temperature, power-on hours, bad sectors, health and a problem sensor with the risk reasons, plus a quick SMART test.

features.title: Drives and shares
features.text: Usage of every shared and personal drive, with quota, members, snapshots and remote backup as attributes.

features.title: System and network
features.text: CPU load and temperature, memory, uptime, network throughput and the link speed, so a port stuck at 1 GbE stands out.

features.title: Fan profile
features.text: Quiet, default or cooling, switchable from Home Assistant, for example quiet at night.

features.title: Data scrubbing
features.text: State and last run of the scrub, and a button to start one.

features.title: UniFi OS and Drive updates
features.text: Both appear under Settings, Updates, with an install button, just like in the UniFi interface.

features.title: Local and discovered
features.text: Talks to UniFi OS on your network, no cloud account. A UNAS is discovered on its own, even after renaming it.

entities.title: Storage
entities.text: storage_used, storage_free, storage_capacity, storage_usage, storage_status, storage_read and storage_write.

entities.title: Problems and health
entities.text: storage_problem, disks_at_risk, hottest_disk, data_scrubbing and last_data_scrubbing.

entities.title: Per disk
entities.text: temperature, power_on_hours, bad_sectors, health, problem and run_quick_smart_test, on a device per disk.

entities.title: System
entities.text: cpu_load, cpu_temperature, memory_usage, started, network_receive, network_transmit and link_speed.

entities.title: Services and controls
entities.text: smb, time_machine and nfs as binary sensors, fan_profile as a select, restart, shut_down and start_data_scrubbing.

entities.title: Updates
entities.text: update.unas_2_unifi_os and update.unas_2_unifi_drive with the installed and the latest version.

title.name: UniFi UNAS
title.sub: Storage, every disk with its health, drives, fan profile, data scrubbing and updates, read from UniFi OS and UniFi Drive. Local, no cloud, nothing installed on the NAS.
